entities.summary: Maikel Antonio Franco, is a Dominican professional baseball third baseman for the Diablos Rojos del México of the Mexican League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Philadelphia Phillies, Kansas City Royals, Baltimore Orioles and Washington Nationals, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Tohoku Rakuten Golden Eagles.
